choice_data_list: Good morning, did you get some good rest?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, plenty! Over the break, I even 
managed to rewatch the past PreFie series!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Purify☆'s [Stars], set in outer space, is 
great and all, but wouldn't you say Purify 
vs. Dark Purify is equally hard to pass 
up~?

It seems getting plenty of rest has helped 
restore her energy.
